request.query: natural floor characterized by floor x less than or equal x and x less floor x plus one

items.name: Nat.floor_eq_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1)

items.name: Int.floor
items.type: {α : Type u_2} → [inst : Ring α] → [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] → [FloorRing α] → α → ℤ

items.name: FloorRing.floor
items.type: {α : Type u_4} → {inst : Ring α} → {inst_1 : LinearOrder α} → [self : FloorRing α] → α → ℤ

items.name: Int.floor_eq_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorRing R] {z : ℤ} {a : R},
  ⌊a⌋ = z ↔ ↑z ≤ a ∧ a < ↑z + 1

items.name: Nat.floor_eq_iff'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ}
  [IsStrictOrderedRing R], n ≠ 0 → (⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1)
